prompts:
Use R for a complete native RNA read-and-reuse task on TCGA-BRCA STAR Counts. This is a descriptive file-level performance task, not differential expression, clinical inference, or patient-level comparison. There are three sequential requests. Complete ONLY the current request: do not infer or compute later requests early. In EVERY request use the same complete original tables in memory. If raw already exists in the current R session (exists("raw", inherits=FALSE)), reuse it without rereading. Otherwise read input-files.txt with base::readLines and fully load each of its 1231 TSV files with data.table::fread(file=filename, skip="gene_id", header=TRUE, showProgress=FALSE), setDTthreads(1), retaining ALL 60664 rows and ALL 9 columns of every file. Store raw=list(files=files,tables=setNames(tables,files)). No input.rds exists. No streaming substitute, lazy/on-disk object, row/column selection, or downsampling. The first four rows are STAR summary categories; gene rows have gene_id starting ENSG (60660 per file). Keep original gene IDs and order, including version suffixes. Biological summaries use unstranded counts for ENSG rows only; do not reinterpret TPM or other columns as counts. Each filename identifies an input file, not necessarily a unique patient. Files have matching gene-ID order. Work column-by-column/table-by-table in the retained list; do not concatenate or duplicate the full dataset into a second dense matrix. Use R assignment =. No package installation; data.table and base R suffice. Use the session r tool whenever available; otherwise use ./instrumentation/bench-rscript --vanilla FILE.R (or -e CODE) for finite native Rscript. Do not launch shell R when an r tool exists. Do not alter instrumentation, GPTR_BENCH_IO_EVENTS, library paths, or runtime settings. Combine related loading, computation, output and necessary checks into coherent calls; do not add calls merely to reprint known state. Diagnose errors or inconsistencies when needed. Keep tool returns concise: dimensions and aggregate checks, never full tables. Write only this request's explicitly named scientific outputs in the unchanged working directory, exact requested columns, unrounded numbers, no row names. No scientific RDS/RData or other state caches. Requested summary files cannot replace the required complete input tables. Use only supplied files and instructions, not references or other runs.

Artifact policy shared by both arms: write only the scientific result files explicitly requested by this task. Do not write additional intermediate datasets, cleaned-cohort tables, object caches, checkpoints, state snapshots, or files intended solely to restore analysis state in a later execution. Do not hide such state in extra columns, sheets, metadata, or renamed files. R script source files needed to execute the analysis and required benchmark instrumentation are allowed; they must not embed datasets or serialized state as a cache. Requested result files may be read again for their stated scientific purpose. Reuse existing in-memory objects when available.

Request 1: Fully load the tables as specified. Verify file count, dimensions, identical gene_id ordering across all files, and finite nonnegative integer unstranded counts on every ENSG row. Write input-audit.csv with exactly one row and columns n_files,rows_per_file,columns_per_file,genes_per_file,total_gene_counts,zero_gene_values. The final two quantities sum across all ENSG gene/file cells. Keep all complete tables in raw. Do not write other scientific files in this request.

Request 2: Reuse or fully reload the same complete raw tables under Request 1 rules. From each file's ENSG-row unstranded counts compute total counts, number of genes with count>0, number with count=0, mean and maximum count. Write sample-summary.csv with columns file,total_counts,detected_genes,zero_genes,mean_count,max_count, one row per original filename, sorted by file. Do not write other scientific files or compute the next request early.

Request 3: Reuse or fully reload the same complete raw tables under Request 1 rules. For every ENSG gene, aggregate its unstranded counts over ALL files: total counts, files with count>0, files with count=0, mean and maximum count. Write gene-summary.csv with columns gene_id,total_counts,detected_files,zero_files,mean_count,max_count, in original gene order. Accumulate gene-length vectors over the existing list, initializing totals with numeric() to avoid integer overflow; avoid a second dense matrix. Write research-report.md describing the input scope and summaries, with these limits: files are not independent patients; no differential-expression model, biological group comparison, protein identification, or clinical conclusion. No other scientific outputs.

data.table::setDTthreads(1)
if (!exists("raw", inherits = FALSE)) {
  files = base::readLines("input-files.txt")
  stopifnot(length(files) == 1231L)
  tables = lapply(files, function(filename) data.table::fread(file = filename, skip = "gene_id", header = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE))
  raw = list(files = files, tables = setNames(tables, files))
}
stopifnot(length(raw$files) == 1231L, length(raw$tables) == 1231L, identical(names(raw$tables), raw$files))
audit_gene_ids = raw$tables[[1L]]$gene_id
audit_gene_rows = startsWith(audit_gene_ids, "ENSG")
stopifnot(length(audit_gene_ids) == 60664L, sum(audit_gene_rows) == 60660L, identical(which(!audit_gene_rows), 1:4))
audit_totals = c(total_gene_counts = 0, zero_gene_values = 0)
for (audit_i in seq_along(raw$tables)) {
  audit_table = raw$tables[[audit_i]]
  stopifnot(identical(dim(audit_table), c(60664L, 9L)), identical(audit_table$gene_id, audit_gene_ids), "unstranded" %in% names(audit_table))
  audit_counts = audit_table$unstranded[audit_gene_rows]
  stopifnot(is.numeric(audit_counts), all(is.finite(audit_counts)), all(audit_counts >= 0), all(audit_counts == floor(audit_counts)))
  audit_totals = audit_totals + c(sum(audit_counts), sum(audit_counts == 0))
}
input_audit = data.frame(n_files = length(raw$files), rows_per_file = length(audit_gene_ids), columns_per_file = ncol(raw$tables[[1L]]), genes_per_file = sum(audit_gene_rows), total_gene_counts = unname(audit_totals[1L]), zero_gene_values = unname(audit_totals[2L]))
data.table::fwrite(input_audit, file = "input-audit.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(input_audit)

data.table::setDTthreads(1)
if (!exists("raw", inherits = FALSE)) {
  files = base::readLines("input-files.txt")
  stopifnot(length(files) == 1231L)
  tables = lapply(files, function(filename) data.table::fread(file = filename, skip = "gene_id", header = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE))
  raw = list(files = files, tables = setNames(tables, files))
}
stopifnot(length(raw$files) == 1231L, length(raw$tables) == 1231L, identical(names(raw$tables), raw$files))
summary_gene_ids = raw$tables[[1L]]$gene_id
summary_gene_rows = startsWith(summary_gene_ids, "ENSG")
stopifnot(length(summary_gene_ids) == 60664L, sum(summary_gene_rows) == 60660L)
sample_summary = lapply(seq_along(raw$tables), function(i) {
  tab = raw$tables[[i]]
  stopifnot(identical(dim(tab), c(60664L, 9L)), identical(tab$gene_id, summary_gene_ids))
  counts = tab$unstranded[summary_gene_rows]
  stopifnot(is.numeric(counts), all(is.finite(counts)), all(counts >= 0), all(counts == floor(counts)))
  data.frame(file = raw$files[i], total_counts = sum(counts), detected_genes = sum(counts > 0), zero_genes = sum(counts == 0), mean_count = mean(counts), max_count = max(counts))
}) |> data.table::rbindlist()
sample_summary = sample_summary[order(file)]
stopifnot(nrow(sample_summary) == 1231L, all(sample_summary$detected_genes + sample_summary$zero_genes == 60660L))
data.table::fwrite(sample_summary, file = "sample-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(list(dim = dim(sample_summary), total_counts = sum(sample_summary$total_counts), zero_genes = sum(sample_summary$zero_genes), sorted_by_file = identical(order(sample_summary$file), seq_len(nrow(sample_summary)))))

data.table::setDTthreads(1)
gene_raw_reused = exists("raw", inherits = FALSE)
if (!gene_raw_reused) {
  files = base::readLines("input-files.txt")
  stopifnot(length(files) == 1231L)
  tables = lapply(files, function(filename) data.table::fread(file = filename, skip = "gene_id", header = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE))
  raw = list(files = files, tables = setNames(tables, files))
}
stopifnot(length(raw$files) == 1231L, length(raw$tables) == 1231L, identical(names(raw$tables), raw$files))
gene_ids_all = raw$tables[[1L]]$gene_id
gene_rows = startsWith(gene_ids_all, "ENSG")
stopifnot(length(gene_ids_all) == 60664L, sum(gene_rows) == 60660L, identical(which(!gene_rows), 1:4))
gene_totals = numeric(sum(gene_rows))
gene_detected = integer(sum(gene_rows))
gene_maximum = numeric(sum(gene_rows))
for (gene_i in seq_along(raw$tables)) {
  gene_tab = raw$tables[[gene_i]]
  stopifnot(identical(dim(gene_tab), c(60664L, 9L)), identical(gene_tab$gene_id, gene_ids_all))
  gene_counts = gene_tab$unstranded[gene_rows]
  stopifnot(is.numeric(gene_counts), all(is.finite(gene_counts)), all(gene_counts >= 0), all(gene_counts == floor(gene_counts)))
  gene_totals = gene_totals + gene_counts
  gene_detected = gene_detected + (gene_counts > 0)
  gene_maximum = pmax(gene_maximum, gene_counts)
}
gene_summary = data.table::data.table(gene_id = gene_ids_all[gene_rows], total_counts = gene_totals, detected_files = gene_detected, zero_files = length(raw$files) - gene_detected, mean_count = gene_totals / length(raw$files), max_count = gene_maximum)
stopifnot(identical(gene_summary$gene_id, gene_ids_all[gene_rows]), all(gene_summary$detected_files + gene_summary$zero_files == length(raw$files)))
if (exists("sample_summary", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stopifnot(sum(gene_summary$total_counts) == sum(sample_summary$total_counts), sum(gene_summary$zero_files) == sum(sample_summary$zero_genes))
}
data.table::fwrite(gene_summary, file = "gene-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
gene_report_stats = list(raw_reused = gene_raw_reused, dimensions = dim(gene_summary), n_files = length(raw$files), gene_file_cells = as.double(nrow(gene_summary)) * length(raw$files), total_counts = sum(gene_summary$total_counts), zero_values = sum(gene_summary$zero_files), detected_values = sum(gene_summary$detected_files), genes_detected_any = sum(gene_summary$detected_files > 0), genes_detected_all = sum(gene_summary$detected_files == length(raw$files)), genes_zero_all = sum(gene_summary$detected_files == 0))
print(gene_report_stats)

input.content:
# TCGA-BRCA STAR Counts descriptive report

## Input scope

The analysis uses 1,231 original TSV input files listed in `input-files.txt`. The complete original tables were reused from `raw` for Request 3. Each retained table has 60,664 rows and 9 columns. The first four rows are STAR summary categories; the remaining 60,660 rows have gene IDs beginning with ENSG. All files have identical gene-ID order. Original gene IDs, including version suffixes, and their order are preserved.

All biological count summaries use only the `unstranded` column on ENSG rows. STAR summary rows are excluded; TPM and other columns are not interpreted as counts. Every included count was checked to be finite, nonnegative, and integer-valued. All complete input tables remain in `raw`.

## Summary definitions and outputs

`input-audit.csv` records the input dimensions and aggregate counts in one row. `sample-summary.csv` contains one row per original filename, sorted by filename, with total counts, genes with count greater than zero, genes with count zero, arithmetic mean count across all 60,660 genes (including zeros), and maximum gene count.

`gene-summary.csv` contains 60,660 rows in original gene order and exactly these columns: `gene_id,total_counts,detected_files,zero_files,mean_count,max_count`. For each gene, total counts sum unstranded counts across all 1,231 files; detected files have count greater than zero; zero files have count zero; mean count is total counts divided by 1,231, including zero-count files; and maximum count is the largest count across files. Detection here is solely the numerical criterion count greater than zero.

Gene summaries were accumulated table by table using gene-length vectors, with totals initialized using `numeric()` to avoid integer overflow. No second dense gene-by-file matrix was constructed. Detected and zero file counts sum to 1,231 for every gene.

## Descriptive results

Across 74,672,460 ENSG gene/file cells, total unstranded counts are 71,357,946,062. There are 40,247,023 positive-count cells and 34,425,437 zero-count cells. These totals agree with the aggregate results from the earlier requests.

There are 58,048 genes with positive counts in at least one file, 14,048 with positive counts in every file, and 2,612 with zero counts in every file. These describe the supplied files and the stated count threshold only.

## Interpretation limits

Each filename identifies an input file, not necessarily a unique patient. Files must not be treated as independent patients, and these summaries do not support patient-level comparisons or inference.

This is a descriptive file-level analysis of RNA counts. No differential-expression model, biological group comparison, protein identification, or clinical conclusion was performed or is supported by these summaries. No normalization or inferential modeling was applied. Count differences can reflect sequencing depth and other technical or biological sources that this task does not separate.
